title: Leyline Resonance : FPS where you reload every gun by hand. Major DEMO released
author: 8paindev
selftext:
The new main menu for Leyline Resonance, a single-player tactical FPS where you reload every gun by hand. Behind the menu the camera tours the three stages: the Academy raid at night, a crash site in the jungle, and a jeep chase down a jungle track. Hover a stage and the background cuts to it.

How AI is used in this project

\- Code: Claude Code. I design and direct; Claude writes most of the GDScript and the tooling.

\- Levels: baked from code, not drawn at runtime. Claude writes Python and Godot generator scripts that bake real scenes, so we can still open and hand-edit every node in the editor. 

\- 3D models: Tripo. A Gemini concept image goes through Tripo image-to-3D, then a Blender script cleans it up and sets the real size. We never decimate the meshes (that tore holes in them). Some props, the guns and the Academy's interior kit are modelled in code instead.

\- No AI voices. We dropped AI voice acting. Characters "speak" in synthesised babble under their captions, generated from scratch by a script.

DEMO click >> [https://8paindev.itch.io/leyline-resonance](https://8paindev.itch.io/leyline-resonance)
